question: What is the difference between Senior Choice and Golden Solution at American Amicable?
answer: Both Senior Choice® and Golden Solution® are whole life final expense policies from American Amicable for ages 50–85 in Nebraska. The main difference is coverage amount: Senior Choice® goes up to $50,000 while Golden Solution® goes up to $25,000. Both offer the same three benefit structures (Immediate, Graded, and Return of Premium) and the same available riders. If you need more than $25,000 in coverage, Senior Choice® is the better fit.

question: What benefit plan types does American Amicable Senior Choice offer?
answer: American Amicable Senior Choice® comes in three benefit structures: (1) Immediate Death Benefit — full coverage from day one, no waiting period for qualifying applicants (Policy Form No. 9767); (2) Graded Death Benefit — reduced benefit during the first years for natural causes, full benefit after the waiting period (Policy Form No. 9644); (3) Return of Premium Death Benefit — if death occurs during the initial period, premiums paid are returned (Policy Form No. 9645). Which plan you qualify for depends on your health profile.

question: What is a Return of Premium Death Benefit plan?
answer: A Return of Premium Death Benefit plan is a type of modified benefit final expense policy. If the insured passes away during the initial benefit period (typically the first 2 years) from natural causes, the policy pays back all premiums paid — not just a percentage. After the initial period ends, the full face amount is paid. This is a middle option between a fully graded plan (which pays only a percentage of premiums) and an immediate benefit plan (which pays full face amount from day one). American Amicable offers this option on both Senior Choice® and Golden Solution®.
